### Base policies (relevant clauses)
`hecm_evt_loc_draw` ↔ `line_of_credit_draw_rules` §1–§8 and facet *Line of Credit Draw Limits…* (min 500.00, phone 15000.00, wire 5000.00, methods, 5 business days, 180 days — all equal to variant parameters); `hecm_evt_disbursement_return` ↔ `returned_and_voided_disbursements`; `hecm_payment_plan_change` ↔ `payout_plan_change_rules` §1–§8 and facet *Scheduled Monthly Payments…* (fee 20.00 / 0.00, terms 12–360, horizon 100). Untriggered branches (pre-anniversary room, phone-only earmark, schedule-basis inspection, set-aside fallbacks, term-based release, annual-adjustable rate tier, 2–6 compounding tiers) are all carried.
